reasoning: The brief carries no substantive intent text ('x'), no director notes, and no observed evidence beyond three uncharacterised 1024x1024 stills, so nothing licenses speech, music, lettering, replacements, or invented narrative facts. All three images are therefore wired as redraw references for the generated clip rather than as frame anchors: with composition unknown and no frame role requested, treating any of them as an exact first/last frame would smuggle in an unrequested pin. Two are assigned subject responsibility and one environment, the minimal neutral split that lets the clip stay faithful to the referenced content without asserting specifics about the pictures. Shot count is kept low (2 of a permitted 4) because there is no requested beat structure to cover, and each shot names only a real change in framing rather than a decorative cut. Duration is fixed at the target's 5167ms with the second shot comfortably above the 1200ms floor. Balanced creativity permits a score but does not require one, and with no stated mood or action a score would be an invented fact about the media, so none is added; requested therefore stays false on speech, music, and on-screen text, and no prohibitions were stated so forbidden stays empty.
